2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch adds tests for the GUEST_MEMFD_FLAG_BIND_NODE flag in KVM's guest_memfd feature. The tests cover various scenarios, including single and multi-node systems, invalid arguments, and edge cases such as non-zero padding and out-of-range node numbers. The tests ensure that the BIND_NODE flag behaves correctly when used with other flags and when faults occur on remote nodes.
